notes: Advisor plan Phase 5B. Starter questions for an empty Chat conversation. Each lane names the account fact that makes a question worth asking (packages/core/src/resolvers/chat-starters.resolver.ts). {behavior} is filled with one of the person's own Behavior titles. advice_card names the advice card a question draws on, when there is one. Adding or rewording a question is a content change with no code change.

starters.text: What is on today?
How is my week going?
What did I skip this week?
What has improved this month?
Which Behavior is strongest, and which is weakest?
What should I do next today?
Can I still fit everything in today?
Everything is done today. How did the week go?
Should {behavior} move for good?
Which items are still unmarked?
Help me catch up on unmarked items.
Why does {behavior} keep slipping?
How could I make {behavior} easier to start?
Is {behavior} set at the right time?
What keeps {behavior} going so well?
Could I pair something new with {behavior}?
What changed this week?
How do I get back on track after a slow week?
This week is going better. What is working?
How long does a new routine take to stick?
What could I tie my new Behaviors to?
Am I trying too many things at once?
Which day of the week is hardest for me?
Do I do better in the morning or the evening?
Have I put too much in one hour?
Which Behaviors do I tend to do together?
Which Behaviors still need a length or a place?
